maeTask: Zero-shot 55-way misconception classification from question, incorrect answer and reference correct answer. No topic restriction or example demonstrations.
baselines: TF-IDF cosine over the same candidate descriptions
majority label learned from dev split
devUsedFor: majority baseline only; no prompt or threshold tuning
appSuite: author-created Japanese regression cases on the three existing demo questions; not an independent benchmark and not educator-reviewed
errorPolicy: Stop on first transport/API/schema failure; preserve completed rows; no silent retry or fabricated predictions
limitations: MaE English task is not the Japanese app
Agreement with original labels does not establish pedagogical correctness
Wilson interval is descriptive and does not account for clustered examples
No evidence of learning gains, graph validity, or best remediation
